comment: Written by hand, not generated. Binding an NFLOG group needs CAP_NET_ADMIN in the owning
user namespace, which a test process does not have, so the tracing agent never observes
these downcalls. The FFM check (buildtools/ffm-check) treats the committed set as a superset
of what the agent records, so it will not delete them.
Verified by running the native binary inside a container network namespace.
